value.rationale: Same twelve icosahedral frozen caps are inaccessible from outside under synchronous neighbor-majority but become reachable from three-spin initial sets under asynchronous Glauber updates. The closed Bernoulli-p law quantifies a >39-fold unbiased update-protocol contrast and identifies its unique maximum. This is a motivated complete finite kinetic benchmark for metastable domain nucleation, not a mere list of known fixed points.
